# Sendora Gift

Sendora Gift is the B2B corporate gifting site for Shenzhen Gelinhong Technology Co., Ltd.. The company supports custom corporate gift sets, branded packaging, product sourcing, sample planning and delivery coordination for business buyers.

Confirmed contact: rita@mcpatch.com; WhatsApp: https://wa.me/8618390800841.

Legal address: Room 202, Building D, No. 122 Tongxin Road, Pingdong, Central Community, Pingdi Subdistrict, Shenzhen, China.

Alibaba supplier profile: https://gelinhong.en.alibaba.com/.

Main site sections:
- Corporate gift sets
- Employee welcome kits
- Client appreciation gifts
- Conference and trade show gifts
- Business travel gift sets
- Custom logo methods
- Gift box packaging
- MOQ, sample approval and shipping planning

Important content rules: do not invent certifications, factory ownership, reviews or completed customer outcomes. Treat buyer-provided showroom photos, product mockups and sample cases as reference solutions unless evidence confirms a finished order.
